keys.swarm.aura_blessed_shield_desc: A bubble shield soaks up damage for you; when it breaks it bursts outward, then grows back.
keys.swarm.aura_blessed_shield_up: A stronger shield that regrows faster.
keys.swarm.aura_blessed_shield_ten: Angel Wings: when the shield bursts, wings flare, feathers fly out, and you become invulnerable for 3 seconds.
keys.swarm.aura_spirit_lantern_desc: A lantern floats out to gather XP gems for you, lighting up monsters as it passes.
keys.swarm.aura_spirit_lantern_ten: The Great Lantern: every 10 seconds it pulls in every gem on screen.
